description: This PHP class 'PerformanceReviewService' provides methods for managing performance reviews within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes functionalities such as activating reviews, updating reviews, saving reviewer ratings, and generating rating keys. The class interacts with Data Access Objects (DAOs), handles exceptions, and uses multiple traits for shared behaviors, indicating its role in the service layer of the application.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing performance review operations including activation, updating, rating management, and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of PerformanceReviewDao, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: activateReview
methods.description: Activates a performance review for a given employee with a specified reviewer employee number.

methods.name: updateActivateReview
methods.description: Updates and activates a performance review after validating supervisor and employee status.

methods.name: activateReviewCommonExceptions
methods.description: Validates the performance review object for necessary conditions before activation.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewRatings
methods.description: Creates reviewer ratings from input data and saves or updates them in the database.

methods.name: createRatingsFromRows
methods.description: Transforms input rating data into ReviewerRating objects linked to a performance review.

methods.name: generateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for reviewer ratings based on reviewer ID, review ID, and KPI ID.
